Introduction

HyeRin is a South Korean dancer, singer, and actress under MODHAUS. She is a member of the girl group tripleS and its sub-units Acid Angel from Asia, ACID EYES, LOVElution, Visionary Vision, and Sun.

HyeRin was introduced as the second member of the girl group tripleS on May 17, 2022. She first debuted with the sub-unit Acid Angel from Asia on October 28, 2022, with the mini album "ACCESS". With their first ten revealed members, tripleS debuted on February 13, 2023, with the mini album "ASSEMBLE".

She made her acting debut in December of 2018, through the web drama "Between Us", after signing an exclusive contract with Kids Planet. She left the agency sometime in 2019.
